summary: In this excerpt from Book 2, the narrator confronts Dawna Polk, who has turned Tresting against them and reveals she may have Rio kill the narrator if Rio has switched sides. Tresting, horrified by his own betrayal, is overwhelmed with guilt and vomits, while the narrator responds with dark humor and refuses to panic because she trusts Rio completely. The passage is a fiction scene of manipulation, guilt, and loyalty.
one_line: In Book 2, the narrator faces Dawna Polk's threat to have Rio kill her while the guilt-stricken Arthur Tresting falls apart.
key_facts: Dawna Polk tells the narrator that if Rio is not on her side, it would be time to cut their losses.
Dawna says that if Rio turns out to be against them, the narrator's sacrifice would spare her friend.
Tresting cries "Twisted" at Dawna and declares he will never trust another word she says.
Dawna tells Tresting he would come back to them in a heartbeat as soon as she brought him around.
Dawna stops, puts a hand to her temple, and says it has been a trying few days.
Tresting says "No" when Dawna asks whether he would prefer to be in another room.
Arthur asks "What she gonna do?" and the narrator answers that Dawna is going to have Rio kill her.
Arthur throws up and mumbles that the betrayal is his fault because he listened to Dawna.
The narrator says Dawna can seduce someone and shove him back the other way, so Arthur has been un-brainwashed.
The narrator warns Arthur that if he ever sells out Rio again, she will kill him.
The narrator says she should be the one freaking out, and that her impending death trumps Arthur's guilt complex meltdown.
The narrator says she trusts Rio completely.
The narrator compares Dawna's claim that Rio would kill her to insisting that pi equals three or that one equals two.
Dawna Polk is described as having skills that the narrator implies make her dangerous.

entities.name: Dawna Polk

entities.name: Rio
entities.role: the narrator's trusted ally, whom Dawna claims may have been turned and would kill the narrator

entities.name: Arthur Tresting
entities.role: Mr. Tresting, who was manipulated by Dawna, betrayed Rio, and is overcome with guilt
